title: xfunc-roadmap-alignment-prep-maya-2026-02
content:
Purpose:
Prep notes for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Personal scratchpad — bring these signals and open questions to the meeting; capture commitments + owners.

Meeting frame (30-40m):
- 0-5m quick context: Q2 goal framing (Lina)
- 5-15m Eng constraints + infra runway (Rajesh)
- 15-25m Model onboarding priorities + eval/regressions (Priya)
- 25-35m Decisions + tradeoffs (open)
- 35-40m Action items + next check-in cadence

Key decisions we need by EOD Fri 2026-02-20:
1) Finalize the list of 3 model variants for Hosted API GA (cost/latency/quality tradeoffs)
2) Commit to latency SLOs for dedicated customers (p50/p95 target ranges)
3) Approve experiment runway (2 A/B experiments for caching + quantization)

Signals to bring / talking points:
- Product: expected customer demand profiles (Lina to share customer beta list)
- Eng: realistic throughput w/ current autoscaler + ROS (Rajesh — show perf run spreadsheet numbers)
- ML: eval regressions observed on prompt-set v1.4 (Priya has summary, bring top 3 failing prompts)

Open questions / friction points (to surface):
- Capacity: can we guarantee burst capacity for initial GA? If not, what fallback policy? (fallback -> smaller model variant?)
- Observability: can we get token-level cost breakdowns per-route within 2 weeks?
- Model rollout gating: what metric threshold constitutes rollback for a new model (latency increase + quality drop)?

Risks (brief):
- Shipping without cache strategy -> 2-3x cost spike on peak traffic.
- Rushed quantization -> subtle hallucination regressions not caught by current eval set.
- Dependencies on infra team for kernel selection changes (lead time ~3 weeks).

Dependency tracker (quick):
- INF-2345 (autoscaler perf improvements) — blocking dedicated SLOs
- ML-778 (eval harness updates) — needed to detect regressions for A/B experiments
- PR 612 (serving-runtime batching) — may reduce p95 by ~20% once merged/deployed

Mini decision matrix (for meeting):
- Option A: Ship with 3 model variants + conservative SLOs — lower feature surface but safer ops.
- Option B: Ship with 2 variants + aggressive SLOs — higher risk of fallbacks, faster adoption.
- Option C: Delay GA 2 weeks, finish cache infra and eval harness — buy more confidence, risk losing momentum.

Suggested asks (what I will ask live):
- Rajesh: confirm if autoscaler improvements can land on staging by 2026-02-24 (yes/no + blockers).
- Priya: show top 5 prompt failures and expected human-level impact; can we add 50 new adversarial prompts by next week?
- Lina: are we ok with a rolling canary for 10% traffic for first week? If not, what threshold is acceptable?

Prep slides / one-pager bullets (for quick share):
- Q2 GA intent + 3 top customer scenarios
- Perf delta table (current vs target) p50/p95/token-cost
- Risk mitigation: caching, fallback, canary plan
- Ask: commit dates + owners for INF-2345, ML-778, PR-612

Actions (live tracking — fill during meeting):
- A1: Rajesh -> share perf spreadsheet w/ tuned autoscaler runs (due 2026-02-18)
- A2: Priya -> export eval failures + suggested fixes, prioritize top 10 prompts (due 2026-02-19)
- A3: Lina -> confirm customer beta list + ask customers about acceptable canary exposure (due 2026-02-20)
- A4: Maya (me) -> draft GA one-pager + decision matrix and circulate (due 2026-02-18)
- A5: Omar -> allocate one infra engineer to kernel-selection work (confirm by 2026-02-19)

Notes-to-self / quick reminders:
- Keep tone pragmatic; push for dates not vague promises.
- If eng pushback on capacity, propose a staged region rollout (NA first, EU next).
- Capture any SLAs requested verbatim in the meeting and log in INF-2345.

Potential follow-ups after meeting:
- Short technical deep-dive (30m) with SRE + infra to scope kernel changes and regression testing.
- Align with Solutions Eng on docs & runbooks for private deployments (hand-off PR).
- Set next alignment check for 2026-02-25 (tentative)

Scratch / brainstorming (free-form):
- Could we run a small synthetic load test with cache enabled vs disabled to quantify cost delta? (quick experiment)
- Idea: temporary feature-flag to reduce max tokens on heavy routes during peak to protect p95.
- If we delay GA, offer early access to top 5 customers as a ‘beta’ to manage expectations.

End of notes.

-- Maya
(Will convert to agenda email if we get greenlight)
